output.question: Where can I find Hermès' latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Hermès’ latest annual report is its 2025 Universal Registration Document, which includes the annual financial report. Find it on Hermès’ official Financial publications page at https://finance.hermes.com/en/financial-publications/ and select “Access in PDF” or “Access the digital format.”
